result.summary:
I've written the round-3 missions for seed 805. `scripts/c05_check.py 805 3` returns ADMISSIBLE.

**Slot a (E):** core is `ts_skew(day_wstd(Volume, Vwap), 50)`, the D axis from M3, with 11 seeds. I did not pick the analyst's suggested C-axis core `cross_mean(day_corr(Ret, Volume), 20)`. The C axis already has 7 heads, so a third dig there would only produce more C x X heads, which add little after dedup in the equal-weight fusion. Pairing C with new screens is covered in the N slot instead. D is the only axis no tool has touched; the risk is that it has had no ablation, and same-round R measures it but cannot feed back into this run.

**Slot b (N):** 12 seeds that lay out conditional double-sort segmentation as y x screen x exclude/select x width. It includes the selection version of the library's C x late-trading exclusion head as a direct contrast.

**Main design choices:**
- No seed restricts to small caps only, and no screen is a reward control. The A axis showed that this kind of nonlinear rewrite of a control slips past the |rho| < 0.5 gate (1.55 fell to 0.11 when bucketed by the known family).
- Bands are chosen so seeds stay under the 0.7 rank ban. With an independent screen, a 20% exclusion band correlates about 0.68 with the ranking variable itself and a 10% band about 0.82; 40% gives about 0.52. A screen that is itself a library head needs a 20% band to stay near 0.48.

**R (16 variants):**
- One test of the C x A structure z-scored within known-family deciles, attached to head 1.40. It is the only variant on that head, so nothing else can take its replacement slot.
- Two cleanups in the same family: head 0.90 loses its self-screening layer; head 0.53's 1-day screen becomes a 20-day smoothed screen with a 40% band.
- Seven measurements on the D head (level vs skew, Vwap weight, windows 25/100, kurtosis, known-family buckets, daily-volume skew).
- Two on the second D head and four on the tail-volatility head.

**Notebook:** I appended a round-3 section to /Users/wxy/Desktop/Partura/research/coldstart_C05/partura/s805/notebook.md. It has the current beliefs, prior predictions for every task and R variant, and a check of all round-2 predictions. Of the 16 round-2 R predictions, 9 were right and 7 wrong. Every big miss came from changing a screen or conditioning variable.
